rejection.bannerDetail: Reason reported by the PDF engine: {{detail}}
rejection.replacement-too-long.explanation: The replacement is longer than the text it replaces. Keep it the same length or shorter so the surrounding layout stays intact.
rejection.text-not-found-in-content-stream.tooltip: Text not found in the PDF
rejection.text-not-found-in-content-stream.explana: The text could not be located in the page's content stream. It may be part of an image, or drawn with an encoding the writer cannot match.
rejection.no-content-stream.tooltip: This page has no editable content
rejection.no-content-stream.explanation: The page carries no content stream to edit. Scanned and image-only pages look like this; run OCR to read them, but the recognised text is an overlay and cannot be written back.
rejection.empty-original-text.explanation: The selected text is empty, so there is nothing for the writer to find and replace.
rejection.page-not-found.explanation: The page this edit belongs to is not in the document any more. Reopen the file and try again.
rejection.encoding-not-supported.explanation: This font's encoding cannot be written to directly. CID fonts, Identity-H/V and custom encodings are not editable in this version.
rejection.font-encoding-unsafe.explanation: The font behind this text uses an encoding (CID, Identity-H/V) that makes a direct replacement unsafe. Only Latin-encoded fonts can be edited.
rejection.glyph-risk-detected.tooltip: Some characters may be missing from the font
rejection.glyph-risk-detected.explanation: The replacement contains characters the embedded font may not carry, which would leave empty boxes in the PDF. Stick to characters the original text already uses.
rejection.document-signed.explanation: This document carries a digital signature, and changing the text would make that signature invalid. Remove the signature first if the text has to change, then sign the document again.
rejection.permissions-denied.explanation: The document permissions do not allow its content to be modified. Open it with the owner password, or ask whoever produced it for a copy without that restriction.
rejection.tagged-text-conflict.tooltip: Tagged text would disagree with what is shown
rejection.tagged-text-conflict.explanation: This text is tagged for screen readers with wording of its own. Replacing the visible characters would leave the two saying different things, so the edit was refused.
rejection.unsupported-container.tooltip: This text lives outside the page content
rejection.unsupported-container.explanation: The text is drawn from a reusable object or from a stream this page shares with another one. Editing it there would change more than this page, so it is not editable in this version.
rejection.mixed-style-span.tooltip: Selection spans more than one style
rejection.mixed-style-span.explanation: The selected text uses more than one font or size, and the writer can only replace a stretch that is set in a single style. Select a smaller piece that looks the same throughout.
rejection.internal-error.tooltip: The edit could not be completed
rejection.internal-error.explanation: The PDF writer stopped with an unexpected error. Save the document and try again.

fallback.fontSubstitutedTitle: A standard font wrote the new text
fallback.fontSubstitutedMessage: The original font of this text has no glyph for one or more characters you typed, so Helvetica was used for the replacement. The text is correct; it may look slightly different from the rest of the line.

fallbacks.xfaScriptsNotRunTitle: Some form scripts are not run
fallbacks.xfaScriptsNotRunMessage: Your answer is saved. This form contains FormCalc scripts ({{count}} found) and PDFluent runs JavaScript scripts only. Totals and fields those scripts would update keep their saved values until the form is opened in Adobe Reader.
fallbacks.xfaScriptsFailedTitle: Some form scripts did not complete

fallbacks.xfaFieldRefusedTitle: The form did not accept the value

fallbacks.xfaFieldRejected: The field “{{field}}” does not accept that value: {{reason}}
fallbacks.xfaFieldNotFound: The field “{{field}}” is no longer in the form. The form was reloaded.
fallbacks.featureUnavailableTitle: '{{feature}}' is not available in this build
fallbacks.usageRightsInvalidatedTitle: This document is no longer Reader-enabled
fallbacks.usageRightsInvalidatedMessage: Your change was made. It also invalidated the usage-rights signature this PDF carried, which let Adobe Reader fill in and save the form. The text edit stands; the extended rights are gone and cannot be restored by undoing it.

signedSave.title: This document is signed
signedSave.message: The redaction removes content the signature covers, so it cannot be saved over the signed original without breaking the signature. Save a copy instead: the copy keeps the redaction and does not carry the signature.

area.pages-organize: Rotate, reorder, merge or split pages

feedback.whatHappenedRequired: Tell us what happened, so we know where to look.

feedback.emailInvalid: This does not look like an email address.
feedback.consentContact: PDFluent may email me with questions about this report.
feedback.consentFixed: Email me when this is fixed.

feedback.privacyNotice: Innovation Trigger B.V. receives this report to improve PDFluent. Reports are kept for up to 24 months. You can have yours removed at any time.

feedback.sentDocumentFailed: Your report arrived, but the document could not be uploaded. You can send the report again with the document if it matters.

feedback.failedNetwork: PDFluent could not reach the server. Nothing was sent, and your text is still here.
feedback.failedRateLimited: Too many reports from this connection today. Please try again tomorrow.
feedback.failedRejected: The report was not accepted. Please check the form and try again.
feedback.failedServer: Something went wrong on our side. Your text is still here; please try again in a moment.
feedback.fixedOffered: Version {{version}} fixes your report {{ids}}. Thank you for telling us.
feedback.fixedAfterUpdate: Your report {{ids}} is fixed in this version. Thank you for telling us.

corrupt.title: This PDF is damaged
corrupt.body: PDFluent could not read this file. It may have been damaged while it was downloaded or copied, or the app that made it wrote it incorrectly. Download or copy it again, or open the original and export it as a PDF again.

not_pdf.title: This is not a PDF
not_pdf.body: PDFluent opens PDF files. This file is something else, or its name does not end in .pdf. Choose a PDF, or if this file is a PDF, rename it so the name ends in .pdf.

empty.title: This file is empty
empty.body: The file has no content (0 bytes). A download or copy may not have finished. Download or copy it again, then open it.

encrypted_needs_password.title: This PDF needs a password
encrypted_needs_password.body: This PDF is protected with a password. Open it again and enter the password. If you do not know it, ask the person who sent you the file.

wrong_password.title: That password did not work
wrong_password.body: The password does not open this PDF. Check for typing mistakes and Caps Lock, then try again.

unsupported_encryption.title: PDFluent cannot open this kind of protection
unsupported_encryption.body: This PDF is protected with a certificate or a security method PDFluent does not support, so no password can open it here. Ask the sender for a copy without protection, or one protected with a password.

too_large.title: This file is too large
too_large.body: This file is larger than PDFluent can open safely. Split or compress it in the app that made it, then open the parts.

too_many_pages.title: This PDF has too many pages
too_many_pages.body: This document has more pages than PDFluent can open at once. Split it into smaller documents in the app that made it, then open the parts.

io_denied.title: PDFluent may not read this file
io_denied.body: Your computer did not give PDFluent permission to read this file. Check the file's permissions, or move it to a folder such as Documents, then try again.

not_found.title: This file could not be found
not_found.body: The file may have been moved, renamed or deleted, or it is on a drive that is no longer connected. Find the file and open it again.

unknown.title: This file could not be opened
unknown.body: Something went wrong while opening this file. Try again. If it keeps happening, let us know so we can fix it.

formBar.calcUnsupported: The scripts in this form are not supported here, so they are not run.
formBar.autoLinksTitle: Links open in your browser automatically. Click to turn this off.
